atoms.title: VLANs and network segmentation
atoms.objective: Explain what a VLAN is, describe how network segmentation limits the spread of an attack, and assign hosts to VLANs to enforce separation between different trust zones.

atoms.title: Traffic isolation and zero-trust segmentation
atoms.objective: Explain the limitations of traditional network segmentation, define the core principles of Zero Trust Network Architecture (ZTNA), and apply traffic isolation and microsegmentation strategies to prevent lateral movement.
